reviews.criteria: Fresh individual primary protocol and owner FAQ read in full, with all eight published centres; current dogs/cats invitation. Pathologist-confirmed listed accessible solid tumors, approximately1–5cm, intratumoral Kv9, no concurrent chemotherapy; selected immunomodulatory medication exceptions explicit. Prior surgery allowed with injectable residual/recurrent disease. Source does not establish lymphoma, oral treatment, oncolytic microbe therapy or an administered cancer vaccine; no benefit guarantee. Study drug/visits covered; diagnosis and unrelated care owner-paid. Cat-specific histology/site criteria remain team screening.

field_review.intervention: Intratumoral Kv9 immunotherapy, usually up to three treatments about two weeks apart, followed by at least nine monitoring visits over two years
field_review.eligibility: Pathologist-confirmed cytology or biopsy; accessible tumor approximately 1–5 cm. No concurrent chemotherapy or disallowed immune-modulating medication, but the protocol explicitly permits Apoquel, Cytopoint, Beransa and recent vaccination. Soft tissue sarcoma must not have surface wounds; other tumor types are assessed individually. Residual/recurrent tumors after surgery may qualify if at least 1 × 1 cm remains. Full referral, feline-specific criteria, medication exceptions and site availability require KVS screening.
field_review.funding: Kv9, treatment appointments and study monitoring visits are covered. Owners pay the initial tumor diagnosis and other veterinarian-recommended tests. Unrelated care, pre-existing conditions and agreed exclusions remain owner-paid; travel coverage is not stated.
